name: open-knowledge-map
description: Evidence-grounded knowledge object infrastructure for textbooks and AI learning systems.

scripts.artifact:export: npm run build -w packages/server && node scripts/export-public-artifact.mjs --allow-unreviewed && npm run artifact:viewer
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/viewer && concurrently -n server,viewer -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/server -- --host 0.0.0.0" "npm run dev -w packages/viewer"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/pipeline && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/viewer
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start -w packages/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w packages/types && npm run check -w packages/pipeline && npm run check -w packages/server && npm run check -w packages/viewer
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/pipeline && npm test -w packages/server && npm test -w packages/viewer
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
